name: DDM
caveats: Parameterised by SwissParam, which does not record the CGenFF version its parameters derive from, so running this solute under a CHARMM36 tree assumes CGenFF 4.x compatibility rather than demonstrating it. The reference protocol this project reproduces obtained the same solute from the CHARMM-GUI.
provenance: Identity and charge read from ITP. SwissParam detected; CHARMM36 July 2022 / TIP3P selected for the supported adapter. GROMACS preprocessing must resolve parameters; scientific validation is not established.
